body.heading: Where in the world is Palau?
paragraphs: Palau is a country in Micronesia, which is part of Oceania. It is an island country, surrounded by sea.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Palau is Ngerulmud. Ngerulmud is one of the smallest capitals in the world — a government village on the big island of Babeldaob. Most Palauans live in Koror, the old capital.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Palau speak Palauan and English. Palauan is the language of everyday life; English is also official and widely spoken.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Palau is the US dollar. Yes — the very same dollars used in the United States!

body.heading: How big is Palau?
paragraphs: Palau covers about 459 square kilometres of land and inland water.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Palau's Rock Islands are mushroom-shaped isles in turquoise lagoons — and in Jellyfish Lake you can swim among millions of stingless golden jellyfish.
On Palau's big island, jungle trails lead to the country's tallest waterfall, and ancient stone monoliths at Badrulchau stand in mysterious rows.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Palau on a map or globe. Which continent is it nearest to — and what sea or ocean surrounds it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
